t: This is St Peter's, a Victorian Anglican church on Kensington Park Road in Notting Hill, built in the classical style between 1855 and 1857. It was designed by Thomas Allom, who was an architect, artist and topographical illustrator, and a founding member of what became the Royal Institute of British Architects. Allom also designed parts of the elegant Ladbroke Estate around you, and he worked with Sir Charles Barry on the Houses of Parliament. So the church is part of a larger neighbourhood he helped shape.
